per_query.question: Why must the pressing force not be passed through the balls or rollers when a bearing is mounted?

Using flat pressing plates or soft jaw covers helps prevent brinell marks and ensures even pressure distribution [en_brinelling#2].

per_query.question: How can I tell fretting damage from false brinelling in a bearing?
per_query.answer: Fretting damage and false brinelling can be distinguished by their characteristics and conditions [en_brinelling#3]. Additionally, fretting is caused by small oscillatory movements and adhesion-breaking cycles, while false brinelling results from vibration-induced lubricant displacement without rotational motion [en_brinelling#2].
